## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Feb 25, 2026 - Jul 31, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Carlitosalb alb_, Jul 27, 2026, 1/5: "It used to be good, it doesn’t track steps anymore. I have it some time in case it was a glitch, but it’s been more than 6 months and it’s not working. Very disappointed"
            2. _Vronjo_, Jul 31, 2026, 2/5: "I love the workout and trainers. I’ve done a few programs. Lately, the workout pauses in the middle of workout and then crashes 3/4 through. The issue is that I can’t resume where it crashed. I have had to finish the remaining workout without the video."
            3. _Tadow5_, Jul 22, 2026, 2/5: "I’ve made every monthly goal for over two years now. But this month the goal only displayed for the first week of the month. And now with only eleven days left, the goal finally reappears to let me know I’ve missed this monthly goal by ONE DAY!. Years of progress and trophies broken by sketchy software. The broken workouts that continuously stop partway through is annoying enough. But destroying a years-long streak because you refuse to track my progress is unacceptable. Update this app like you do all the others!"
